title: Obstructive Sleep Apnea and Venous Thromboembolism
brief_summary: There is a clear link between obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and cardiovascular disease. However, there has been no clear link between OSA and venous thromboembolism (VTE). The objective of this study is to evaluate such a link.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult patients (\>= 18 years) with sleep study, OSA or VTE

Exclusion Criteria:

* Below 18 years of age
study_population: Adult patients (\>=18 years) with sleep study , OSA or VTE
